document.title: Brocade SANnav Management Portal REST API Reference and Overview

capability_sources.note: Endpoint, response envelope key ("Fabrics"), and field names (name, principalSwitchWwn) confirmed against a real, independently-authored working script, not only vendor prose documentation.
Requires a principalSwitchWWN query parameter. Response envelope key ("Switches") and ipAddress field confirmed against the same working script.

Endpoint path and full request body shape (startTime, endTime, pageSize, startIndex, filters.filter[].includedEvents[]) confirmed from Broadcom's own Python example. The per-event response field names (severity, affected switch, message) could not be independently confirmed during connector construction -- the client counts events defensively across plausible envelope shapes rather than parsing unverified per-event fields. Live verification against a real SANnav instance, or the vendor's authoritative schema reference (the full REST API Reference Manual PDF), is a documented follow-up before this capability is promoted.

authentication_source.note: This connector deliberately uses SANnav's documented session-less mode (Base64 Basic-auth header on every request) instead of the stateful login/sessionId flow, so it fits the existing per-request authorization-header credential materializer pattern already used for every other connector in this codebase without a framework change.

self_test_source.note: SANnav has no confirmed dedicated version/compatibility endpoint equivalent to Hitachi's /configuration/version; the self-test reuses the fabric-discovery read itself and checks for a well-formed response shape.
